_comment: Umbrella / parent organisations that shadow the institution a PI actually works at.
These are DEMOTED, not deleted: an umbrella is never chosen as a PI's primary
institution while any real candidate exists, but it survives in the PI's
institutions[] list because 'this person is CNRS' is true and worth keeping.
Every ID here was verified live against /institutions - a dead ID silently
disables the entry, which is exactly how 26 UK PIs ended up filed under
Add to this list as per-country audits surface more (Italian IRCCS network,
Spanish CIBER, Nordic university hospitals are known gaps).
